name: Improved Lunge (Combat)
body:
You can quickly recover from your lunges, helping you to avoid counterattacks.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 1 rank, Lunge.

Benefit(s): When you use the Lunge feat to increase the reach of your melee attacks by 5 feet until the end of your turn, you do not suffer a penalty to your AC. You cannot use this feat if you carry a medium or heavy load.

Normal: You take a –2 penalty to your AC until your next turn when making a lunge attack.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
